title: Volta STEM Undergraduate Scholarship
summary: Partial tuition support and mentorship for second- and third-year STEM students.
description: The Volta STEM Undergraduate Scholarship supports students in science, technology, engineering and mathematics with partial tuition funding for one academic year, plus quarterly mentorship sessions with practising engineers and scientists. Recipients are expected to take part in one community STEM outreach activity during the year.

title: Software Engineering Internship — Kente Digital
summary: Ten-week paid internship building web and mobile products with a product team in Accra.
description: Interns join a cross-functional product team for ten weeks and ship features to real users. You will work with React and TypeScript on the web, contribute to code reviews and present your work at a final demo day. Each intern is paired with an engineering mentor.
eligibility: Penultimate-year Computer Science or related student
Experience with at least one programming language
Available for the full ten weeks

title: Savannah Climate Leaders Fellowship
summary: Six-month fellowship for students designing community climate adaptation projects.
description: Fellows receive training in climate science, project design and community engagement, then design and pilot a small adaptation project with mentorship. The fellowship includes a stipend for project materials and a final convening with other fellows from across West Africa.
eligibility: Demonstrated interest in climate or sustainability
Commitment of about 5 hours per week

title: Build for Campus Hackathon
summary: A 36-hour hackathon to build tools that improve everyday student life.
description: Form a team of up to four and build a working prototype that solves a real campus problem — from transport to food to study spaces. Mentors are available throughout, and the top three teams receive support to keep developing their projects.

title: Student Ventures Pitch Competition
summary: Pitch your early-stage venture to a panel of founders for seed support and mentorship.
description: Teams submit a two-page summary and a three-minute video pitch. Finalists present live to a panel of founders and investors. Winners receive seed support, a semester of mentorship and workspace at the Innovation Hub.
eligibility: Teams with at least one enrolled student
Venture at idea or early-prototype stage

title: Research Assistant — Community Health Survey
summary: Assist with data collection and analysis for a community health survey over one semester.
description: Research assistants support a team studying access to primary healthcare. Tasks include survey design review, data cleaning and basic statistical analysis in R or Python. Training in research ethics is provided before fieldwork begins.

title: Weekend Literacy Volunteers
summary: Support reading clubs for primary school pupils on Saturday mornings.
description: Volunteers lead small reading groups for pupils at a nearby primary school. You will receive a short orientation and a reading toolkit. Transport is arranged from campus each Saturday.
eligibility: Commit to at least four Saturdays

title: Emerging Leaders Programme
summary: A twelve-week leadership programme with coaching, workshops and a team service project.
description: Participants attend fortnightly workshops on ethical leadership, communication and team management, receive one-on-one coaching and complete a team service project with a local organisation. The programme ends with a public showcase.
eligibility: Evidence of leadership in any setting

title: Data Science Career Bootcamp
summary: Four Saturday sessions on data analysis portfolios, interviews and job search strategy.
description: This bootcamp helps students prepare for data roles. Sessions cover building a portfolio project, SQL and Python interview practice, and how to present your work. Each participant receives individual CV feedback.

title: Renewable Energy Engineering Internship
summary: Field and design internship on solar mini-grid installations.
description: Interns support the design and monitoring of solar mini-grids for rural communities. You will assist with site surveys, load calculations and performance monitoring dashboards.
eligibility: Engineering student in second year or above
Willingness to travel for site visits

title: Student Creative Arts Micro-Grant
summary: Small grants for students producing film, music, visual art or writing projects.
description: The micro-grant funds materials and equipment for student creative projects. Applicants submit a short project proposal, a budget and examples of previous work. Grantees exhibit or perform their work at the end of the semester.

title: Fintech Case Challenge
summary: Teams analyse a mobile-money business case and present recommendations to judges.
description: Teams of three receive a business case on a mobile-money product and have one week to prepare a strategy recommendation. Finalists present to judges from finance and technology backgrounds.

title: Undergraduate AI Research Fellowship
summary: Summer research on machine learning for agriculture and health, with a faculty mentor.
description: Fellows spend eight weeks on a supervised research project applying machine learning to agriculture or health datasets. The fellowship includes a stipend, a reading group and a final research poster presentation.
eligibility: Third-year Computer Science, Engineering or Mathematics student
Coursework in statistics or machine learning

title: Social Enterprise Fellowship
summary: Nine-month support for student-led ventures tackling social challenges.
description: Fellows receive monthly workshops, a dedicated mentor and a small grant to test a social venture. The fellowship focuses on measuring impact and building sustainable revenue models.
eligibility: Student-led venture with a social mission
At least one team member enrolled full-time

title: UX Design Internship
summary: Remote UX internship designing interfaces for financial inclusion products.
description: Interns run user interviews, create wireframes and prototypes, and test designs with real users. You will work closely with a senior designer and present a case study at the end of the internship.
eligibility: Any major with a design portfolio

title: Regional Student Robotics Challenge
summary: Build an autonomous robot to complete an agricultural sorting task.
description: Teams design and program an autonomous robot that sorts produce by size and colour. The challenge rewards reliable engineering, documentation and teamwork. Fabrication lab time is available to registered teams.
eligibility: At least one engineering student per team

title: Health Screening Day Volunteers
summary: Help organise a free community health screening day with partner clinics.
description: Volunteers help with registration, queue management and health education stations during a community screening day. Training is provided the week before the event.

title: Women in Technology Scholarship
summary: Full tuition scholarship and laptop for women studying computing or engineering.
description: The scholarship covers tuition for one academic year and includes a laptop and a mentor from the technology industry. Scholars join a cohort that meets monthly online.
eligibility: Woman enrolled in Computer Science, Information Systems or Engineering

title: Student Journalism Fellowship
summary: Mentored reporting fellowship producing in-depth stories on education and development.
description: Fellows are paired with an experienced editor and produce two in-depth stories over a semester. Workshops cover interviewing, fact-checking, data journalism and media ethics.

title: Supply Chain Analyst Internship
summary: Analyse shipment data and help optimise warehouse operations.
description: Interns support the operations analytics team by cleaning shipment data, building dashboards and recommending process improvements. Strong spreadsheet skills are essential; SQL is a plus.

title: Campus Energy Audit Volunteers
summary: Measure energy use in campus buildings and propose savings.
description: Volunteers learn to use simple energy meters and record usage across campus buildings. The team analyses the data and presents recommendations to facilities management at the end of the semester.

title: Alumni Career Mentorship Programme
summary: Semester-long one-on-one mentorship with alumni working in technology and science.
description: Mentees are matched with an alumni mentor based on career interests and meet at least monthly. The programme includes a kickoff workshop on goal setting and a closing reflection session.
eligibility: Any enrolled student in a STEM field

title: AgriTech Innovation Hackathon
summary: Weekend hackathon building digital tools for smallholder farmers.
description: Teams work with farmer cooperatives to understand challenges, then prototype digital solutions over a weekend. Travel support is available for selected student teams.

title: Model United Nations Delegation
summary: Represent the university at a regional Model UN conference.
description: Selected delegates prepare position papers and represent assigned countries in committee simulations. Training sessions cover diplomacy, negotiation and resolution writing.

title: Essay Competition on African Futures
summary: Essay competition on technology and society in Africa in 2050.
description: Students write an essay of up to 2,000 words imagining how technology could shape African societies by 2050. Winning essays are published in an online anthology.

title: Student Podcast Producer Role
summary: Lead production of the weekly campus podcast for one semester.
description: The producer plans episodes, coordinates hosts and guests, and oversees editing. Training on audio equipment and editing software is provided.

title: Cloud Skills Certification Scholarship
summary: Covers the cost of an entry-level cloud certification exam and study materials.
description: Selected students receive study materials and an exam voucher for an entry-level cloud certification. Study groups meet online weekly.

title: Zero-Waste Campus Challenge
summary: Teams compete to design the most effective waste-reduction intervention.
description: Teams propose and pilot a waste-reduction intervention in a campus space for two weeks, measuring results. The most effective intervention is adopted campus-wide.

title: Quick Cash Online Survey Jobs
summary: Earn money filling in surveys online. Pay a small fee to register.
description: This listing asks students to pay a registration fee before receiving survey work. It was flagged for review because it lacks a verifiable provider.
